question: In March 2021, _________ became the first female Indian cricketer and the second, internationally, after England's Charlotte Edwards, to breach the 10000-run mark in international cricket.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithali Raj.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **​Mithali Raj** on Friday became the first Indian girl cricketer and 2d the world over to complete **10,000 runs.**
 
• Mithali Dorai Raj is an I
